title: IDF Injures and Abducts Palestinians in West Bank Raid
detail: Israeli forces conducted a military operation in the West Bank, injuring and abducting Palestinians. The raid is part of ongoing IDF operations in the occupied territory amid heightened tensions.

title: Israeli Settlers Vandalise Palestinian Home in West Bank
detail: Israeli settlers vandalised a Palestinian home in the West Bank, according to a report by Middle East Eye. Settler attacks on Palestinian property have escalated in the occupied West Bank in 2026.
